title: MWS — RESURVEY_3YR table
description: Array of Million Women Study 3-year ('yellow') resurvey records. One element is one participant's 3-year follow-up record, combining the '3-year resurvey' sheet and the 'Dietary data at 3-year resurvey' sheet (same wave, same grain).
$comment: This table has no participant-identifier field in the source dictionary at all, same as the recruitment table (open item, see DECISIONS.md D007/D047) -- uniqueItems is asserted as standing structural policy but cannot anchor to a real key here, and there is currently no way to link a resurvey_3yr row back to its recruitment row for the same participant.
